sections.title: SRN PLAINS/ARKLATEX/LOWER TO MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW WILL MOVE ACROSS THE RIO GRANDE VALLEY INTO THE WRN TX HILL COUNTRY ON SUNDAY AS A 70 TO 90 KT MID-LEVEL JET ROUNDS THE BASE OF THE SYSTEM. AT THE SFC...A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS EAST TX TODAY. THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD BE ONGOING ALONG THE FRONT AT THE START OF THE PERIOD. AS SFC TEMPS WARM EARLY IN THE DAY...THUNDERSTORM INTENSITY SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE AS A SQUALL-LINE ORGANIZES AND MOVES EWD ACROSS EAST TX. A MOIST WARM SECTOR WITH SFC DEWPOINTS NEAR 70 F ALONG WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR STRONG UPDRAFTS WITH CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE SQUALL-LINE. MORE DISCRETE THUNDERSTORMS MAY ALSO DEVELOP AHEAD OF THE LINE FROM THE ARKLATEX SSWWD TO THE HOUSTON AREA DURING THE AFTERNOON. FORECAST SOUNDINGS FROM LUFKIN TO HOUSTON TOMORROW AT 21Z SHOW STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR PROFILES FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS. 0-6 KM SHEAR IS ESTIMATED FROM 55 TO 60 KT. IN ADDITION...0-3 KM SHEAR IS FORECAST TO BE IN THE 350 TO 400 M2/S2 RANGE SUGGESTING THE ENVIRONMENT WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR TORNADOES. TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ROTATING CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE AND WITH THE MORE DISCRETE CELLS JUST AHEAD OF THE LINE. A STRONG TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE FROM THE

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...SOME CAPABLE OF PRODUCING TORNADOES...DAMAGING WINDS...AND HAIL...WILL MOVE ACROSS EASTERN TEXAS...FAR SOUTHEAST OKLAHOMA...AND INTO PARTS OF ARKANSAS AND LOUISIANA THROUGH THIS EVENING...AND THEN ACROSS THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY TONIGHT. A FEW THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS MAY ALSO AFFECT PARTS OF THE OHIO VALLEY.

sections.title: EAST TX INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: MORNING WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A DEEP UPPER LOW SOUTH OF ELP...WITH STRONG LARGE-SCALE LIFT SPREADING EASTWARD ACROSS CENTRAL TX. THIS LIFT WILL OVERSPREAD A SLOW-MOVING SURFACE COLD FRONT THIS MORNING...LEADING TO LOW-LEVEL CYCLOGENESIS AND STRENGTHENING CONVERGENCE/VERTICAL SHEAR ACROSS EAST TX. THIS PROCESS IS EXPECTED TO RESULT IN A PERIOD OF ENHANCED RISK OF SEVERE STORMS...INCLUDING TORNADOES...OVER PARTS OF EAST TX/SOUTHEAST OK/NORTHWEST LA/SOUTHERN AR. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INTENSIFY THIS MORNING ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE FRONT OVER PARTS OF EAST TX...WHERE 12Z RAOBS AND VAD PROFILES INDICATE STRONG LOW LEVEL VERTICAL SHEAR AND FAVORABLE INSTABILITY. FORCING ALONG THE COLD FRONT WILL LIKELY LEAD TO A LINEAR MCS...BUT SUFFICIENT LOW LEVEL SHEAR MAY SUPPORT A RISK OF LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS AND QLCS TORNADOES TODAY. A FEW DISCRETE SUPERCELLS ARE ALSO EXPECTED TO DEVELOP TODAY IN THE WARM SECTOR AHEAD OF THE FRONT. THESE STORMS WOULD LIKELY POSE THE GREATEST RISK OF STRONG TORNADOES. THE MAIN THREAT IS EXPECTED TO SHIFT NORTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF NORTHWEST LA/SOUTHERN AR THIS AFTERNOON AS THE LOW LEVEL JET TRANSLATES EASTWARD.

sections.title: OH VALLEY
sections.text: MORNING SOUNDINGS SHOW AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE...MARGINAL INSTABILITY...AND VERY STRONG LOW LEVEL WIND FIELDS ALONG A FRONT EXTENDING FROM WESTERN KY TO SOUTHERN OH. THUNDERSTORMS ALONG THE FRONT MAY RESULT IN A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS. ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS ARE NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME. ..HART/COHEN.. 12/27/2015

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A MID TO UPPER-LEVEL LOW CENTERED ALONG THE RIO GRANDE VALLEY NEAR PRESIDO TX WILL ACCELERATE NEWD INTO THE RED RIVER VALLEY IN RESPONSE TO THE PROGRESSION OF A 90-100 KT JET STREAK AT 500 MB AND AN ACCOMPANYING VORTICITY MAXIMUM EJECTING FROM NRN MEXICO THROUGH ERN TX. THIS UPPER-AIR PATTERN EVOLUTION WILL PROMOTE THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SURFACE LOW FROM THE LOWER TX COASTAL PLAIN THROUGH THE ARKLATEX INTO OZARK PLATEAU WHILE TRAILING COLD FRONT SURGES EWD THROUGH THE SABINE RIVER VALLEY.

sections.title: ERN TX INTO THE LOWER-MS VALLEY
sections.text: ANALOGOUS TO THAT WHICH UNFOLDED SATURDAY FARTHER TO THE WEST...A GRADUAL INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR TODAY ACROSS ERN TX INTO PORTIONS OF SWRN AR AND WRN LA. HERE...THE LEADING EDGE OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA PRECEDING THE UPPER-AIR SYSTEM WILL PROMOTE THE DEEPENING OF CONVECTIVE UPDRAFTS ALONG PREFERRED LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE ZONES AHEAD OF THE PRIMARY FRONT/QLCS. 12Z RAOB DATA INDICATE AN ANOMALOUSLY MOIST AIR MASS WHICH WHEN COUPLED WITH THE ONSET OF DAYTIME HEATING --ALBEIT MODEST-- WILL CONTRIBUTE TO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. AND GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR...THE SETUP WILL SUPPORT THE MATURATION OF WARM-SECTOR STORMS INTO SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF TORNADOES --SOME POSSIBLY STRONG--...DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. BY THIS EVENING INTO TONIGHT...THE MORE DISCRETE CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS PRESENT IN THE WARM SECTOR WILL BE GRADUALLY OVERTAKEN BY THE CONVECTIVE BAND ACCOMPANYING THE COLD FRONT WHICH WILL BE ACCELERATING EWD THROUGH THE SABINE INTO LOWER-MS VALLEYS. WHILE THE OVERALL TORNADO THREAT MAY BEGIN TO WANE AT THAT TIME...THE POTENTIAL FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS COULD INCREASE AS THE DEEP-L

sections.title: CNTRL INTO NRN TX TODAY
sections.text: CONTINUED MOISTURE TRANSPORT ATOP THE DEEPENING FRONTAL ZONE AND ADIABATIC COOLING PRECEDING THE UPPER LOW WILL YIELD A THERMODYNAMIC STRATIFICATION CONDUCIVE FOR A FEW STRONG STORMS CAPABLE OF SMALL TO MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL NWD TOWARD THE RED RIVER. ..MEAD/GLEASON.. 12/27/2015

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...SOME CAPABLE OF PRODUCING A COUPLE OF TORNADOES...DAMAGING WINDS...AND HAIL...WILL MOVE FROM EASTERN TEXAS AND ACROSS PARTS OF ARKANSAS AND LOUISIANA THROUGH THIS EVENING...AND THEN ACROSS THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY TONIGHT.

sections.title: UPDATE
sections.text: ONLY SMALL ADJUSTMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO THIS OUTLOOK BASED ON CURRENT RADAR TRENDS. DESPITE WIDESPREAD DEEP CONVECTION AHEAD OF THE DEEP MID-UPPER LOW CURRENTLY TRACKING ACROSS THE BIG BEND REGION OF TX...MOST STORMS HAVE REMAINED DISORGANIZED WITHIN THE PRIMARY BAND OF ASCENT FROM NEAR MATAGORDA BAY ON THE TX GULF COAST NORTH ACROSS THE ARKLATEX. WATER VAPOR LOOP APPEARS TO SUGGEST A STRONGER SPOKE OF DPVA PIVOTING AROUND THE DEEP LOW AND SPREADING ENEWD FROM THE RIO GRANDE. LIFT WITH THIS IMPULSE...AND A COINCIDENT INCREASE IN STRENGTHENING MID-LEVEL FLOW DIRECTED ACROSS THE BAND OF CONVECTION THROUGH THE EVENING...MAY PROMOTE GREATER FORWARD PROPAGATION WITH STORMS MOVING INTO A MOIST AND MODESTLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS RESIDING OVER LA. WILL MAINTAIN THE RELATIVELY HIGHER TORNADO AND WIND PROBABILITIES GIVEN THIS POTENTIAL INTO THE EVENING. ..CARBIN.. 12/27/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1026 AM CST SUN DEC 27 2015/

sections.title: EAST TX/SRN AR/LA/MS/WRN TN
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW WILL MOVE INTO CNTRL TX TONIGHT AS A 80 TO 100 KT MID-LEVEL JET ROUNDS THE BASE OF THE SYSTEM. AT THE SFC...A LOW WILL MOVE NEWD ACROSS THE ARKLATEX REGION AS A COLD FRONT ADVANCES EWD ACROSS FAR EAST TX INTO LA AND THE LOWER MS VALLEY THIS EVENING INTO TONIGHT. A BROKEN LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING ALONG THE FRONT AND THIS WILL CONTINUE TO ORGANIZE INTO A SQUALL LINE. SFC DEWPOINTS AHEAD OF THE FRONT ARE NEAR 70F AND THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE INSTABILITY. THIS WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STRONG UPDRAFTS WITH CELLS ALONG THE LINE AND WITH DISCRETE THUNDERSTORMS THAT DEVELOP ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR. AS THE EXIT REGION OF THE MID-LEVEL JET PASSES ACROSS THE REGION THIS EVENING...STRONG CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE MAINTAINED. THE BEST ENVIRONMENT FOR SEVERE STORMS APPEARS TO BE IN NW LA AT THIS TIME. THE 00Z SOUNDING FROM SHREVEPORT SHOWS MUCAPE OF 1300 J/KG WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 60 KT AND 0-3 KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITY NEAR 460 M2/S2. THIS SHOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AND A THREAT FOR TORNADOES. THE GREATEST TORNADO THREAT WILL BE WITH DISCRETE CELLS THAT DEVELOP ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR AHEAD OF THE FRONT. A TORNADO THREAT WILL ALSO EXIST WITH ROTA

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SMALL TO MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY OCCUR WITH ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED FOR THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ELEVATED CONVECTION OCCURRING ABOVE A SHALLOW SFC STABLE LAYER WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE NWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF N-CNTRL TX/FAR S-CNTRL OK THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. COOLING MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES/STEEPENING LAPSE RATES AND A SATURATED LOW TO MID-LEVEL PROFILE ARE ALL SUPPORTING UP TO 500-1000 J/KG OF MUCAPE ACROSS THE MCD AREA PER LATEST RAP MESOANALYSIS. NLY WINDS UP TO 1 KM AGL ASSOCIATED WITH A SFC COLD FRONT ARE PRESENT ON THE KFWS VWP...AND SWLY TO SLY WINDS ATTENDANT TO AN APPROACHING CLOSED LOW ARE STRENGTHENING WITH HEIGHT FROM 2-10 KM. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES GENERALLY RANGE FROM 45-55 KT ACROSS THIS REGION. GIVEN SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH STRONG SHEAR ABOVE 1 KM...ORGANIZED THUNDERSTORMS WITH SMALL TO MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL UP TO 1 INCH IN DIAMETER WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED IN THIS POST-FRONTAL REGIME GIVEN THE MARGINAL NATURE OF THE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW 571...WITH THIS WATCH EXPANDED IN AREA TO INCLUDE A FEW MORE COUNTIES IN SOUTHWEST AR THAT REMAIN IN THE WARM SECTOR. NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO OCCUR ALONG THE COLD FRONT AND WITHIN PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE ZONES ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR. AS THE COLD FRONT MOVES INTO THE WESTERN PART OF WW 571 AND THE NEAR-SURFACE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES...STORMS SHOULD BECOME LESS CONDUCIVE TO PRODUCE TORNADOES...THOUGH HAIL AND/OR STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 18Z...GREATER SURFACE PRESSURE FALLS WERE NOTED IN SOUTHEAST TX WITH AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE BECOMING BETTER DEFINED NEAR UTS. THIS LOW IS FORMING ALONG A SLOW EASTWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT THAT EXTENDED FROM EXTREME SOUTHEAST OK THROUGH EAST TX TO ALONG OR JUST EAST OF THE SOUTH TX COAST. THE SURFACE ANALYSIS INDICATED THE PORTION OF THE COLD FRONT IN AR IS ORIENTED GENERALLY WEST-EAST...EXTENDING FROM EXTREME SOUTHEAST OK TO 10 S HOT TO APPROXIMATELY 20 NE PBF...AND THEN NORTHEAST INTO EXTREME SOUTHWEST TN /JUST NORTH OF MEMPHIS/. THE TX PORTION OF THE COLD IS FORECAST TO MAINTAIN A SLOW EAST MOVEMENT...WHILE THE W-E ORIENTED BOUNDARY IN SOUTHERN AR MAY ADVANCE A LITTLE MORE TO THE SOUTH...BUT SHOULD STALL IN THE NORTHERN EXTENT OF WW 571 LATER THIS AFTERNOON. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED BREAKS IN THE CLOUDS ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR IN EAST TX...LA AND SOUTHERN AR THAT HAVE ALLOWED SURFACE TEMPERATURES TO RISE INTO THE UPPER 70S TO AROUND 80 F. THIS COMBINED WITH THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST AIR MASS IS RESULTING IN MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG IN EAST TX AND WRN/SRN LA...WHILE OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED MLCAPE OF 500-1000 J/KG IN SOUTHERN AR. SPECIAL 18Z SOUNDINGS AT SHV/LCH CONFIRMED THE OBJECTIVE THERMODYNAMIC ANALYSIS AND ALSO INDICATED STRONG KINEMATICS PERSISTED...WITH SOUTHEASTERLY SURFACE WINDS VEERING AND STRENGTHENING IN THE LOWEST 1 KM TO SLY AT 50 KT. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT AND SFC-3-KM SRH EXCEEDING 300 M2/S2 REMAINS QUITE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH A TORNADO THREAT. ..PETERS.. 12/27/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS APPEARS TO BE INCREASING ACROSS THE AREA AND CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BREAKS IN THE CLOUDS HAVE ALLOWED TEMPERATURES TO WARM TO AROUND 80 DEGREES AS OF EARLY AFTERNOON...WHICH WHEN COUPLED WITH A VERY MOIST AIR MASS HAS RESULTED IN MLCAPE OF 750 TO AROUND 2000 J/KG PER 18Z SHV AND LCH RAOBS. RECENT TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR/VISIBLE SATELLITE DATA INDICATE DEEPENING CONVECTION OVER CNTRL LA /INVOF ESF/ ALONG N-S ORIENTED CONFLUENCE BANDS/CLOUD STREETS. WHILE THE STRONGEST LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL REMAIN TO THE WEST OF THE SABINE RIVER VALLEY THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON...CONTINUED HEATING AND RESULTANT DEEPENING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER MAY BE SUFFICIENT TO INITIATE STORMS WITHIN THESE EVOLVING CONVECTIVE BANDS. SHOULD THIS OCCUR...THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR /REF. THE ABOVE-MENTIONED SOUNDINGS AND CURRENT FT. POLK VAD/ AND TENDENCY FOR STORMS TO BE MORE DISCRETE IN NATURE SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR TORNADIC SUPERCELLS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED AND A WATCH MAY BECOME NECESSARY PRIOR TO 20 OR 21Z. EVEN IF STORMS DO NOT MATERIALIZE WITHIN THIS REGIME...WRN PORTIONS OF THE MCD AREA WILL LIKELY BE INCLUDED IN A NEW TORNADO WATCH PRIOR TO 22Z AS ONGOING UPSTREAM STORMS SHIFT EWD INTO WRN LA AND SWRN AR. ..MEAD.. 12/27/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED SOON WITH WFO/S WITH COUNTIES AND/OR PARISHES IN PARTS OF EAST TX...LA...AND SOUTHERN AR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT MOVING INTO EAST TX...WHILE NEW STORMS ACROSS FAR NORTHERN LA INTO FAR SOUTHERN AR ARE GROWING DEEPER WITH LIGHTNING DETECTED AND AN INCREASE IN LOW-MID LEVEL ROTATION. GIVEN THESE OBSERVATIONS AND THE METEOROLOGY PRESENTED IN SPC MCD/S 2084 AND 2085...A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS HAVE RECENTLY INCREASED IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ACROSS THIS REGION...WITH A DAMAGING WIND AND TORNADO THREAT. WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITHIN A BROAD WAA REGIME AND WELL AHEAD OF A CLOSED LOW NOW EMERGING FROM NRN MEXICO...CONVECTION HAS INCREASED IN COVERAGE OVER THE PAST HOUR ACROSS PORTIONS OF ERN LA AND SRN/CNTRL MS. A MINOR PERTURBATION IN THE MID TO UPPER LEVEL FLOW MAY ALSO BE PARTIALLY RESPONSIBLE FOR THIS RECENT DEVELOPMENT. REGARDLESS...ACTIVITY WITHIN THIS REGIME WILL HAVE ACCESS TO MLCAPE OF 500-1500 J/KG...AS TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE UPPER 70S/NEAR 80...AND DEWPOINTS HAVE INCREASED INTO THE MID 60S TO LOWER 70S. ALTHOUGH WINDS ALOFT ARE SOMEWHAT WEAKER COMPARED TO LOCATIONS FURTHER W AND CLOSER TO THE EWD MOVING UPPER LOW...EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 40-50 KT PER VWP AT KJAN AND RAP MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATES WILL BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION AND MINI-SUPERCELL STRUCTURES...WITH AN ATTENDANT DAMAGING WIND/ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT. WHILE NOT IMMEDIATELY LIKELY...CONVECTIVE TRENDS OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO WILL BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CONTINUED TORNADO THREAT AND AN INCREASING THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS SOUTHEAST TX...INCLUDING THE HOUSTON METRO AREA...AND POSSIBLY TO THE COAST. WFO-HGX /WITH SPC COORDINATION/ HAS EXTENDED THE EXPIRATION TIME OF A PORTION OF WW 571 UNTIL 01Z /7 PM CST/.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A STRONGER LOBE OF VORTICITY IS MOVING THROUGH DEEP SOUTH TX TOWARD THE EAST-NORTHEAST. FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH THIS FEATURE WILL CONTINUE TO AID IN SURFACE LOW DEEPENING ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN SOUTHEAST TX /CURRENTLY IN SOUTHWEST MONTGOMERY COUNTY/. THIS FORCING MAY ALSO ENHANCE THE FORWARD MOVEMENT OF THE COLD FRONT AND ATTENDANT THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS WITH STORMS ALONG THIS BOUNDARY. OTHERWISE...THE COMBINATION OF MODERATE INSTABILITY IN PLACE ACROSS SOUTHEAST TX AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT AND STRONG LOW-LEVEL AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR /SFC-1-KM OF 40 KT AND SFC-6-KM EXCEEDING 50 KT...RESPECTIVELY/ CONTINUE TO FAVOR AN ENVIRONMENT FOR TORNADIC SUPERCELLS INTO THE EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO RISK WILL PERSIST AND POTENTIALLY INCREASE OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS /THROUGH EARLY EVENING/ ESPECIALLY ACROSS SOUTHERN AR AND FAR NORTHEAST TX/NORTHERN LA...INCLUDING THE POTENTIAL FOR A STRONG TORNADO OR TWO. TORNADO WATCH 572 CONTINUES UNTIL 04Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FRAGMENTED SQUALL LINE WITH EMBEDDED/ IMMEDIATE-LINE-PRECEDING SUPERCELLS CONTINUES TO MOVE ACROSS FAR EAST TX TOWARDS FAR SOUTHWEST AR/NORTHWEST LA. DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO OR TWO WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH LINE-EMBEDDED BOWS/MESOVORTICES...BUT THE GREATEST TORNADO POTENTIAL WILL BE WITH SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS AHEAD OF THE BROADER CONVECTIVE LINE. AS OF 445PM CST...NORTH/NORTHEASTWARD DISCRETE SUPERCELLS CONTINUE TO INCREASE ACROSS EXTREME NORTHEAST TX /EASTERNMOST TIER OF COUNTIES/ AND FAR NORTHERN LA INTO SOUTHERN AR. AMID MOIST/CONFLUENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW...THESE SURFACE-BASED STORMS ARE OCCURRING NEAR/SOUTH OF A SYNOPTIC SCALE FRONTAL BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS SOUTHWEST-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHERN AR...WITH ANOTHER MESOSCALE-RELATED EFFECTIVE BOUNDARY CLOSER TO THE AR/LA BORDER VICINITY. ALONG/SOUTH OF THE FRONT...NEAR-SURFACE LOW-LEVEL WINDS HAVE NOTABLY BACKED MORE EAST-SOUTHEASTERLY OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS ACROSS NORTHERN LA/SOUTHERN AR...AND THIS SAME TREND SHOULD CONTINUE/PERSIST VIA MASS RESPONSE TO THE DEEPENING SURFACE LOW ACROSS NORTHEAST TX. CONSISTENT WITH LITTLE ROCK/SHREVEPORT WSR-88D VWP DATA...THIS SCENARIO WILL MAINTAIN 0-1 KM SRH OF AROUND 250-400 M2/S2 THROUGH EARLY/MID-EVENING. ACCORDINGLY...A TORNADO/DAMAGING WIND RISK WILL CONTINUE ACROSS MUCH OF TORNADO WATCH 572...BUT A SOMEWHAT FOCUSED POTENTIAL FOR TORNADOES /INCLUDING A STRONG TORNADO RISK/ APPEARS TO ESPECIALLY EXIST ESPECIALLY ACROSS SOUTHERN AR/EXTREME NORTHEAST TX AND NORTHERN LA. ..GUYER.. 12/27/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR TORNADOES WILL PERSIST THROUGH MID-EVENING ESPECIALLY FROM FAR NORTHEAST TX INTO WESTERN/NORTHERN LA AND FAR SOUTHWEST AR. TORNADO WATCH 572 CONTINUES UNTIL 04Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DUAL MESOSCALE CORRIDORS OF NORTH/NORTHEASTWARD-MOVING SCATTERED SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS CONTINUE ACROSS EXTREME NORTHEAST TX /GENERALLY THE EASTERNMOST TIER OF COUNTIES/ INTO FAR SOUTHWEST AR AND FAR NORTHWEST LA INCLUDING THE SHREVEPORT GENERAL VICINITY AS OF 645 PM CST. AS STORMS CONTINUE TO REGENERATE/PERSIST AND QUICKLY MOVE NORTH-NORTHEASTWARD...THIS SAME SLOW-EASTWARD-SHIFTING CORRIDOR /NEAR AND SOUTH OF THE SW-NE-ORIENTED FRONT ACROSS SOUTHERN AR/ WILL REMAIN AT THE RELATIVELY GREATEST RISK FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES THROUGH MID-EVENING. THE 00Z OBSERVED SOUNDING AND RECENT WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM SHREVEPORT REFLECT 0-1 KM SRH AROUND 300-350 M2/S2...A SCENARIO THAT WILL REMAIN SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELL-RELATED TORNADO POTENTIAL. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR/SRH...IF ANYTHING...WITH ONLY FURTHER STRENGTHEN THIS EVENING AS PER ARKLATEX-VICINITY SURFACE CYCLOGENESIS AND SHORT-TERM FORECAST SOUNDINGS/850 MB GUIDANCE. EVEN WHILE A MODEST NOCTURNALLY RELATED COOLING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER HAS ALREADY BEGUN TO OCCUR EARLY THIS EVENING...AND THE OVERALL RISK MAY BE PAST ITS PEAK...CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY MODEST AMID A SEASONALLY MOIST AIR MASS WITH SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S/NEAR 70 F. DAMAGING WINDS ASIDE...THE MAIN POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL PERSIST/GRADUALLY SHIFT EASTWARD FROM EXTREME EAST TX INTO NORTHWEST/WEST-CENTRAL LA AND FAR SOUTHWEST AR THROUGH MID-EVENING. ..GUYER.. 12/28/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

A NEW/REPLACEMENT TORNADO APPEARS LIKELY FOR LA/SOUTHERN AR AND POSSIBLY FAR WESTERN MS FOR A CONTINUED RISK INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE CORRIDORS WITH BROKEN BANDS OF MODESTLY DISCRETE NORTH/NORTHEASTWARD-MOVING SUPERCELLS CONTINUE AS OF 845 PM CST ACROSS EXTREME EAST TX INTO NORTHWEST LA/SOUTHWEST AR. FACTORS SUCH AS A MODESTLY COOLED BOUNDARY LAYER AND CONTINUED CELL MERGERS SUGGEST THAT THE TORNADO RISK MAY BE PAST ITS PEAK...BUT AN ISOLATED TORNADO/DAMAGING WIND RISK WILL NONETHELESS CONTINUE THROUGH MID/LATE EVENING WITHIN A SEASONALLY MOIST/HIGHLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT. NEAR-SURFACE WINDS CONTINUE TO EXHIBIT AN EASTERLY COMPONENT PARTICULARLY ACROSS NORTHERN LA AND FAR SOUTHERN AR IN AREAS NEAR/SOUTH OF A SOUTHWEST/NORTHEAST-ORIENTED FRONT. WITH VERY STRONG/MODESTLY VEERING WINDS THROUGH THE LOWER/MIDDLE TROPOSPHERE...LATEST WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM SHREVEPORT CONTINUES TO INDICATE AROUND 300 M2/S2 OF O-1 KM SRH. GIVEN THAT AT LEAST SOME TORNADO/DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY CONTINUE ACROSS NORTHERN LA/SOUTHERN AR BEYOND 04Z...AND POTENTIALLY INCREASE ACROSS ADDITIONAL PARTS OF CENTRAL/SOUTHERN LA INTO FAR WESTERN MS AS FORCING FOR ASCENT INCREASES/COLD FRONT ACCELERATES EASTWARD OVERNIGHT...A REPLACEMENT TORNADO WATCH COULD BE NEEDED. ..GUYER.. 12/28/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE WILL CONTINUE/SHIFT EASTWARD OVERNIGHT ACROSS PORTIONS OF LA/FAR SOUTHERN AR AND EVENTUALLY FAR WESTERN MS. TORNADO WATCH 573 CONTINUES UNTIL 11Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE NORTH/SOUTH-ORIENTED BANDS OF LINEAR-DOMINANT CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO MAKE A STEADY NET EASTWARD PROGRESSION OVERNIGHT. A COLD FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY ACCELERATE EASTWARD PARTICULARLY ACROSS CENTRAL/SOUTHERN LA...WITH A RELATIVELY MILD/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER PERSISTING AHEAD OF THIS COLD FRONT. ACCORDINGLY...LOW-LEVEL SHEAR/SRH WILL REMAIN SUPPORTIVE OF EMBEDDED BOWS/MESOVORTICES CAPABLE OF AT LEAST ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE AND A TORNADO OR TWO. ..GUYER.. 12/28/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
